stated_up_front: Hello. I got a bill after I gave the car back and I think it is too much. My letters come to my email.

facts.truth: $450 for a scratch on the rear bumper
yes, twelve photos on my phone

unknowns: what the wear standard in the lease says
whether the bill can be disputed
